articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Different Neural Networks for Sentiment Analysis on IMDb Movie Reviews
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electrical, Computer & Telecommunication Engineering (ICECTE)
abstract: With the huge expansion of text data sentiment analysis is playing a crucial role in analyzing the user’s perspective about a particular product, company or any other physical or virtual entity. Sentiment analysis helps us to analyze user review about an entity and then drawing out a conclusion based on the sentiments it extracted from the reviews. Convolution Neural Network (CNN) and Long-Short-Term Memory Network (LSTM) are two well-known deep neural networks used for sentiment analysis. In this paper, we have compared between CNN, LSTM and LSTM-CNN architectures for sentiment classification on the IMDb movie reviews in order to find the best-suited architecture for the dataset. Experimental results have shown that CNN has achieved an F-Score of 91% which has outperformed LSTM, LSTM-CNN and other state-of-the-art approaches for sentiment classification on IMDb movie reviews.

articleTitle: A Combined Approach Using Image Processing and Deep Learning to Detect Pneumonia from Chest X-Ray Image
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electrical, Computer & Telecommunication Engineering (ICECTE)
abstract: Pneumonia is an epidemic disease that is needed to be detected in the early stage to prevent unfortunate deaths. Traditional methods take a lot of time to detect the disease. With the introduction of Medical Imaging, the detection of disease has been accelerated by using chest x-ray image. But it also requires the availability of an expert and experienced radiologist in order to interpret the x-ray image accurately. Sometimes, manual interpretation is affected by various kinds of artifact in X-ray or Optical Coherence Tomography(OCT) images. For this reason in our paper, we have proposed a combined approach using Image Processing and either VGG-16 or VGG-19, variants of Deep Convolutional Neural Network for automatic detection of pneumonia from Chest X-ray image. We have used Mendeley OCT and Chest X-Ray dataset to evaluate our model. We have achieved an accuracy of 96.2% using VGG-16 and 95.9% using VGG-19, both of which outperform transfer learned InceptionV3 benchmark model used on this dataset which has an accuracy of 92.8%.

Index Terms: ImageNet Large Scale Visual Recognition Challenge

articleTitle: Wavelet Based Feature Extraction for Rice Plant Disease Detection and Classification
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electrical, Computer & Telecommunication Engineering (ICECTE)
abstract: Plant disease is a significant intimidation to both plant diversity and food production, which claims monitoring mechanisms to take the adequate measures for confirming food production, an important sustainable management strategy. In Bangladesh rice in considered as one of the dominant food crop, as most of agricultural lands are used for cultivating rice and it is increasing every year. As production and quality of rice plays an important role in economy and food supply, diagnosis of rice diseases at betimes stage is momentous. The goal of our proposed work is detection and classification of rice plant diseases using simple image processing approach based on wavelet transform. This approach uses the multi-resolutional analysis, Discrete Wavelet Transform (DWT) to perform decomposition of the input image into horizontal, vertical, diagonal sub-bands. Different color and texture features are extracted from horizontal, vertical, diagonal sub-bands of the input image up to 2 levels and considered as features. Classification has been done by using an Ensemble of Linear Classifier adopting the Random Subspace Method (RSM). This proposed technique has successfully classified four prime rice plant diseases named as rice bacterial blight, rice brown spot, rice bacterial sheath brown rot and rice blast with classification accuracy rate of 95 percent.

articleTitle: An Improved Single Phase Transformerless H5 Inverter with Minimized Leakage Current
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electrical, Computer & Telecommunication Engineering (ICECTE)
abstract: This paper, presents an improved single phase transformerless H5 inverter with significantly eliminated leakage current and more effective features where common mode voltage clamping method is used to eliminate the leakage current and super-junction MOSFET are applied to the switches to improve its efficiency. In order to alleviate the AC output current distortion, unipolar PWM technique without any dead time is adopted to the proposed inverter. Around 9.67 mA (RMS) leakage current and 97.78% efficiency have been recorded as optimum performances of the inverter. Moreover, the grid current THD of this enhanced inverter is found 0.68% using conventional LCL filter which is better than existing H5 topology. Hence, the proposed inverter offers superior performances from all aspect over the conventional H5 inverter. The performances of the proposed inverter with theoretical results are verified by simulation carried out in MATLAB/Simulink.

articleTitle: A Trade-off between Energy and Spectral Efficiency in Massive MIMO 5G System
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electrical, Computer & Telecommunication Engineering (ICECTE)
abstract: Energy efficiency is a basic need of the fifth-generation (5G) wireless networks, because the energy sources and capability of the battery are very narrow against the huge demand. Massive MIMO is a great invention of 5G cellular network with a large number of antennas. In this research, the prime aim is to maximize the energy efficiency and spectral efficiency simultaneously of massive MIMO system. Spectral and energy efficiency are formulated with fixed power, number of users, number of antennas with the impact of multiple users and without the impact of multiple users, the ratio of number of antennas and number of users. Trade-off also has been analyzed among the co-located, distributed and hybrid massive MIMO with the Nakagami-m fading channel, which can subtract the co-channel interference in a system and compared with each other. From the simulation results, it is seen that the energy efficiency of distributed massive MIMO is higher than the other two with the variation of fixed power, number of user and the ratio of number of antenna and number of user with respect to spectral efficiency. The energy efficiency of co-located massive MIMO is higher than the other two with the variation of number of antenna.

articleTitle: A Bangla Spam Email Detection and Datasets Creation Approach based on Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electrical, Computer & Telecommunication Engineering (ICECTE)
abstract: Email is one of the most imperative communication mechanisms of the 21st century. People around the world send billions of emails every single day which makes people prone to threats. Spam emails can be used for stealing things from our electric devices, blackmailing and phishing. Moreover, we receive several unwanted emails such as advertisements and offers of e-commerce websites. Due to these emails, we sometimes miss important emails. There are several approaches available for detecting spam emails in the English language and other important languages. However, there is no such spam email detection tool available in Bangla language where Bangla is one of the most spoken languages in the world and widely used on the internet nowadays. For this reason, spammers nowadays send emails in Bangla language to Bengali people so that they can avoid being filtered out which makes us vulnerable to serious threats. Therefore, we have designed and developed a spam email detection mechanism in the Bangla language. We have also constructed datasets of Bangla spam emails to train and test our system. This paper explores the use of six supervised machine learning approaches. According to the classification results, Random Forest presented the best performance with 93.60% accuracy.

articleTitle: A Microcontroller Based Dual Axis Tracking System for Solar Panel
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electrical, Computer & Telecommunication Engineering (ICECTE)
abstract: Solar energy is one of the most promising renewable energy resources that recently have become broader in current technology. This paper presents the technique how Ohm's law and power equation applies to generate more energy from solar photovoltaic (PV) panels. To implement automatic dual axis and a polar single axis solar tracker system is used. It contains a locked vertical axis and a flexible horizontal axis, which is regulated by a motor. To get the maximum power output and highest efficiency, trackers always track the sun and change panel position accordingly. The tracker automatically changes its position after every 2 to 3 degrees of misalignment, to prevent the power loss created by running motor continuously. The light intensities of both sides were compared by the sensors and move the panels towards the light. The panel continuously moves until the tracker detects the equal light falls on both sides. This project helps to improve the solar irradiance of the panel.

articleTitle: Identification of the Risk Factors of Cervical Cancer Applying Feature Selection Approaches
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electrical, Computer & Telecommunication Engineering (ICECTE)
abstract: A risk factor is any attribute that enhances the probability of getting an injury or disease. Cervical cancer has been considered as a frequent type of cancer among women. The attributes that are involved in enhancing the likelihood of cervical cancer are considered as the risk factors of this cancer. If it is possible to point out the risk factors of cervical cancer, the reason behind this disease can be understood easily. Thus, through proper treatment, mortality rate can be minimized and the quality of care can be increased. The aim of this study is to point out the risk factors of cervical cancer and find a model that provides good performance in predicting cervical cancer. In this research, Recursive Feature Elimination (RFE) and an ensemble approach based on Random Forests classifier have been used to identify the factors having much significance in predicting cervical cancer. Support Vector Machine (SVM), Multilayer Perceptron, and Logistic Regression have been used to evaluate the performance. SVM with an ensemble approach based on Random Forests classifier has outperformed than others with the accuracy of 91.04%, specificity of 91.94% , and AUC score of 0.89 for an independent test set.

articleTitle: An 18-Pulse Uncontrolled Star Rectifier for Input Line Current Harmonic Reduction
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electrical, Computer & Telecommunication Engineering (ICECTE)
abstract: This article introduces a delta/fork transformer based 18-pulse uncontrolled star rectifier for large current and low voltage application. The proposed rectifier consists of two 9-pulse parallel connected uncontrolled star rectifier, delta/fork transformer and interphase transformer (IPT). Delta/fork transformer is designed and modeled optimally to produces two 9-phase supplies for two 9-pulse star rectifiers. The proposed rectifier enables to element lower than 17<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sup> order harmonics from the input line voltage and input line current. Total harmonic distortion (THD) of the input line voltage is less than 5% under wide load variation condition. The proposed rectifier suitable where isolation is required such as aluminum potline, traction substations, zinc electrolysis, graphitizing furnaces, copper refining and low voltage ac drives etc. Proposed rectifier is analyzed, designed, modeled and simulated in MATLAB software environment.

articleTitle: Artificial Neural Network Based Maximum Power Point Tracking of a Photovoltaic System
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electrical, Computer & Telecommunication Engineering (ICECTE)
abstract: Nonlinear behavior of photovoltaic system under changing environmental conditions, creates the requirement of designing maximum power point tracker (MPPT). MPPT is an electronic device that enables the system to draw the maximum available power, what PV panel is capable of generating under changing temperature and irradiance by using several types of algorithms and methods. Conventionally perturb and observe (P&O) method and incremental conductance method have been used for designing MPPT, as they provide a simple and cost effective way of tracking. But either they have drawback of slow operation or low tracking efficiency. However, Artificial Neural Networks (ANN) can be deployed for this purpose, as they can track the optimal operating point (MPP) quickly and accurately based on training data sets. This paper presents three ANN based MPPT methods: Direct ANN, Cascaded ANN and the proposed Hybrid method. The ANN's are trained using training data set of maximum power point voltages (V<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">MPP</sub>) from a user defined PV array over different environmental conditions (temperature and irradiance). In this research work, a user defined PV array and three MPPT models are simulated in SIMULINK.

articleTitle: Implementation of Faster R-CNN in Paddy Plant Disease Recognition System
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electrical, Computer & Telecommunication Engineering (ICECTE)
abstract: Objective of this work is focused on developing a system capable of identifying various diseases of paddy plant. Faster RCNN, a model of Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) has been executed for recognition. TensorFlow library has been used in Anaconda environment. Samples of diseased plants were collected from Bangladesh Rice Research Institute (BRRI), Rajshahi. Before initiating training procedure, the data images had to be processed. Then after completion of training program, the recognition was possible automatically. A design of a real time system has also been proposed.

articleTitle: Comparison between Noninvasive Heart Rate Monitoring Systems using GSM Module and ESP8266 Wi-Fi Module
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electrical, Computer & Telecommunication Engineering (ICECTE)
abstract: Advanced technologies and versatile medical instruments are used to diagnose diseases accurately but these are limited to hospitals and clinics, also cost an individual huge amount of money. People prone to cardiovascular diseases, in emergency case such as cardiac arrest and those who need 24-hour monitoring have to access those diagnosis tools frequently is practically bothersome. So, an easy, inexpensive continuous heart rate monitoring mobile device must be introduced. This research study highlights on measuring heart rate information with Arduino Uno and pulse sensor and sending the processed data to a remote location via Global System for Mobile (GSM) communication module and ESP8266 wireless fidelity (Wi-Fi) module. A detailed comparison is made between the two devices in terms of speed, performance and cost.

articleTitle: Energy Efficient Massive MIMO 5G System with ZF Receiver
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electrical, Computer & Telecommunication Engineering (ICECTE)
abstract: The Massive MIMO (multiple-input multiple-output), one of the leading 5G technologies, has brought efficiency, reliability, and robustness of the communication system. Interference and power consumption are the significant problems for Massive MIMO. The Nakagami-m fading channel carries a characteristic like m diversity order, this order is unique because of having co-channel interference reduction feature. That’s why, in this inspection, Nakagami-m fading channel has been used in massive MIMO system. The massive MIMO has various categories such as co-located MIMO, distributed MIMO and hybrid MIMO depending on its base station. In this research, we have exclusively analysed the performance of these three massive MIMO channels and their energy efficiency. This system seems to be less affected by co-channel interference. The MIMOs have been compared using ZF (Zero Forcing) receiver.

articleTitle: Improved performance of Lysine Glutarylation PTM using Peptide Evolutionary Features
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electrical, Computer & Telecommunication Engineering (ICECTE)
abstract: Glutarylation is a new acylated post-translational modification. It is responsible for diverse metabolic functions and biological process. Identification of glutarylation is very significant as it controls different mitochondrial activities. Laboratory methods for identification of glutarylation are costly and take a lot of time. If a computational tool can identify lysine glutarylation sites efficiently, it will both save time and money. In our proposed method, a comparatively new feature extraction technique, peptide evolutionary features, has been used that gave sensitivity of 75.14%, specificity of 99.17%, accuracy of 87.16% and MCC of 0.76 for 5-fold cross-validation and sensitivity of 78.5%, specificity of 99.0%, accuracy of 88.5% and MCC of 0.78 for independent test set. Sequence based feature extraction techniques preserve less information for separating positives and negatives compared to the position specific evolutionary feature extraction technique, proposed in our model. For this reason, the performance of our model outperforms the previously developed tools, MDDGlutar and GlutPred, to a great extent in all the cases.

articleTitle: Artificial Neural Network Based Speed Estimator for Sensorless Field Oriented Control of Three Phase Induction Motor
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electrical, Computer & Telecommunication Engineering (ICECTE)
abstract: The presented work proposes an effective speed estimation scheme based on time series neural network for field oriented controlled three phase induction motor drives. This method utilizes the d and q axis voltage supplied by the SVPWM inverter, electromagnetic torque and rotor flux as inputs to the neural network. The proposed scheme reduces the amount of computational complexity than the Model Reference Adaptive System (MRAS) based speed estimation and provides a better result due to universal function approximation capability of neural networks. Accurate speed estimation at zero and 10 rad/sec proved the effectiveness of the proposed scheme at low speed region. The proposed estimator performs satisfactorily at all the speed levels within the specified motor speed range. At all the four quadrants, the proposed estimator showed stable performance. The performance and stability evaluation of the proposed neural network-based speed estimator was performed in MATLAB/Simulink.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of a Drain Cleaner Robotic Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electrical, Computer & Telecommunication Engineering (ICECTE)
abstract: This work proposed to construct a mobile device which would remove waste materials such as leaves, bottles, polyethylene, etc. which we usually see disrupting the water flow in roadside drains. The system was developed in the context of solving one of the most common problems of our country which is drain clogging. Our system is a four-wheeled robot attached with a wiper motor for moving on the drains. The device also consists of a chain-sprocket based grabber fitted with a fixed number of claws to pick up the waste material. The claws will transfer the collected waste into a deposit box and from there it will be disposed to the desired location utilizing a conveyor system. Chain sprocket mechanism has been utilized in waste grabber and also for moving wheels. The robot can be controlled both manual and automatic dictation through Bluetooth communication.

articleTitle: Galvanic Skin Response signal based Cognitive Load classification using Machine Learning classifier
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electrical, Computer & Telecommunication Engineering (ICECTE)
abstract: Cognitive load (CL) classification is an important research issue in the human-computer interaction paradigm. It is evident from recent research that Galvanic Skin Response (GSR) can be used to sense cognitive load. CL analysis is important for understanding the mental growth of the child and the psychology of patients going through the different traumatic situation. Inspired by such a novel application, this model is designed. In this work, a technique has been demonstrated to measure and evaluate the level of human cognitive load for different tasks by collecting GSR from 40 student participants. The students are asked to sit for a test to solve three different tasks - reading comprehension, solving mathematics, and cracking Sudoku. Time-domain features have been extracted from participant's GSR signals while these tasks are being analyzed. Some parameters such as Correlation Dimension (CD), Lempel-Ziv Complexity (LZC), Hurst Exponent (HE) and Shannon Entropy (SE) are used to analyze CL and these are used as features while accomplishing classification. The Level of stress or cognitive load is strongly observed with the one-way ANOVA test and box-whisker plots. Next, several machine learning algorithms are used to classify the various level of cognitive load. Using the 10 fold cross-validation and Naïve Bayes algorithm 91.5% accuracy is obtained.

articleTitle: A Novel Beamspace Channel Estimation Technique for Millimeter Wave Massive MIMO Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electrical, Computer & Telecommunication Engineering (ICECTE)
abstract: Millimeter-Wave (mmWave) systems fit out an incomparable chance for fulfilling the increasing data rate demands on Fifth Generation (5G) wireless networks. Beamspace with metal plate lens antenna array is a rising technique at mmWave massive MIMO systems in 5G for reducing the RF chains without the performance loss. Yet to manage the capacity of every beam should have perfect Channel State Information (CSI) in low RF chains condition. To overcome this limitation in this paper we propose a Regular Scanning Support Detection (RSSD) based channel estimation scheme. Especially we propose the use of a voltage doubler and a metal plate lens antenna where globose wavefront is reformed into plane wavefront but output wavefront is speeded up by material of lens which increases the spectral efficiency of the system. In the estimation of channel component we first estimate the support with the fading effect and then removed it from total channel estimation problem. Simulation results displays the satisfying accuracy of the proposed RSSD based channel estimation.

articleTitle: Secure Outage Performance Analysis of Multicasting Through α − µ Fading Channel
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electrical, Computer & Telecommunication Engineering (ICECTE)
abstract: This work deals with the development of a mathematical model consisting of the closed form analytical expressions (CFAEs) of the measures which ensures the security in α - μ fading multicast channels. Authors are interested to ensure that no eavesdropper can wiretap any data from the system. Two important secrecy measures namely probability of non-zero secrecy multicast capacity (PNSMC) and the secure outage probability of multicasting (SOPM) are considered to inquire the insight of this proposed work. Results show that the performance analysis of α - μ fading channel includes the performance of Gaussian, Exponential, Rayleigh, Weibull, Gamma, Nakagami-m etc. distributions. So, the generalization of security analysis in fading channels is mostly achieved by the performance evaluation of α - μ fading channel. Finally, the authenticity of analytical outcomes are checked by the Monte-Carlo simulation.

articleTitle: Information-Theoretic Security in Hyper Gamma Fading Channel
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electrical, Computer & Telecommunication Engineering (ICECTE)
abstract: In this paper, the information-theoretic security of a confidential data transmitting through Hyper Gamma fading channel from a source to a receiver in the existence of an eavesdropper has been analyzed. The Hyper Gamma fading model is befitting to the cognitive radio channel as it is dynamic in nature. So, with a view to investigate the security of Hyper Gamma fading channel, the closed form expressions (CFEs) of ergodic secrecy capacity (ESC), probability of non-zero secrecy capacity (PNSC) and secure outage probability (SOP) have been derived in this paper. The numerical data is also presented here to understand the effects of environment fading and average signal to noise ratio of the communication medium. Moreover, the numerical data are verified through Monte-Carlo Simulations.

articleTitle: Remote Real Time Monitoring and Safety System for Earthquake and Fire Detection Based on Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electrical, Computer & Telecommunication Engineering (ICECTE)
abstract: This research project is focused on designing and developing a system that can remotely monitor the status of earthquake or fire, and initiate safety measures to reduce damage. The persons residing in a building can be alerted with the alarm and electric power cut. With timely in-house and remote detection of earthquake or fire, location of ignition and automatic isolation of electric line upon detection of fire, lives can be saved and external help can be sent effectively. The system is based on Arduino Uno board equipped with Microcontroller ATmega328p which processes the environmental signals obtained from vibration and fire sensors. The processed signal is then uploaded to Adafruit.io website via ESP8266 Wireless Fidelity (Wi-Fi) module. In the event of an earthquake and fire, Arduino Uno board switches off the relay and isolates the main electric line to eliminate the risk of fire and electric damage.

articleTitle: Carbon Dioxide Emission from Fossil Fuel: A Procedure for Building a Predictive Model
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electrical, Computer & Telecommunication Engineering (ICECTE)
abstract: Carbon dioxide is immensely increasing in Bangladesh between the last few decades. The use of fossil fuel is one of the reasons for carbon dioxide emission which is rapidly increasing because of the industrial revolution. The burning of fossil fuels, manufacturing of cement, and the burning of solid, liquid, gas fuels and gas flaring are often responsible for Carbon dioxide emissions. In this paper, we established an emerging model that helps to predict the amount of carbon dioxide emission in upcoming years where the model variables are the reasons to create such emissions. The experiment has been conducted on a data repository named WDI-2015 consisting of the development indicators of Bangladesh produced by the World Bank. At first, we separated the vital indicators from the data source and used multiple stepwise linear regressions to build many regression models. Later, the best model was chosen and evaluated using the acceptable standards of Mean Absolute Error, Relative Absolute Error, and Root Mean Square Error under the capability of k-fold cross-validation. Further, we proved the model significance and performance by comparing it with other classifying methods like Gaussian Process, Decision Table, and Random Forests.

articleTitle: A New Approach of Moving Object Detection Using Background Subtraction Method
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electrical, Computer & Telecommunication Engineering (ICECTE)
abstract: Moving object detection has introduced a new challenging horizon in the era of image processing. The main challenge to detect moving objects in all environments because of the complex background. This paper proposes a method that detects a moving object more accurately in almost all the environments. Background subtraction is used in our proposed method for detecting moving objects where the Sauvola algorithm is used on a subtracted image for binary conversion. Median filtering and boundary labeling are used to increase the accuracy of moving object detection. Finally, a morphological operation is performed in our proposed method for detecting the moving object. We tested our proposed method on Wallflower datasets and compare the results of moving object detection on the basis of recall, precision and F-measure with other existing methods. Our proposed method attained successful results for detecting the moving object.

articleTitle: Information Retrieval From Damage OMR Sheet by Using Image Processing
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electrical, Computer & Telecommunication Engineering (ICECTE)
abstract: In this dynamic era, people want to save his or her time as much as possible. They sometimes want the result just after the experiment. The motive of this paper is to scan the OMR sheets and collect data by image processing and matching the current data with the previous one to find out the latest or current results. 1. In today's world many exams are being conducted which offer Multiple Choice Questions to the students. These exams offer Multiple Choice Questions(MCQs) to the examines. Generally in examinations with MCQs, the OMR sheet is used. 2. There are many significant usages of this technology in different sectors such as institutional research, community and consumer surveys, data compilation, product evaluation and so on. It detects the specific pencil marked round bubble from the optical answer sheet of the multiple-choice questions. As it is a manual process, so many errors may occur here. In this paper, such a technique is invented which will overcome the limitations of the OMR machine. This system also works for the damaged sheets which the OMR machine does not at all. By scanning the hard copy of the OMR sheet and created a JPEG format database and a data set is used as the input. Different types of errors and image problems are solved to complete the process. Here the system is build up in MatLab and python language by image processing.

articleTitle: Experimental Analysis of Modified Single Phase Cycloconverter
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electrical, Computer & Telecommunication Engineering (ICECTE)
abstract: This paper proposed a new single phase cycloconverter for ac drives. The proposed cycloconverter consists of specially tapped transformer (STT) with four thyristors. STT has three terminals in secondary winding with two different voltage levels. Secondary side of STT is connected to the two back to back half wave rectifier and load. Proposed cycloconverter converts 50 Hz frequency to 16.67 Hz frequency power supply and produces near to the sinusoidal output voltage. Microcontroller based circuit is designed to generate gating pulses for thyristors, and a prototype is built to verify theoretical and simulation results. Total harmonic distortion (THD) of proposed cycloconverter is 59.09% which is lower than the other existing design. The results show that the proposed method is of practical significance to improve the application level of cycloconverter in speed control of ac drives.

articleTitle: Channel Modeling for Forest Backhaul Networks using Millimeter Wave in 5G Communications
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electrical, Computer & Telecommunication Engineering (ICECTE)
abstract: Tremendous increase of use of smart phones have risen mobile data volume to many folds resulting in spectrum hungry issue in addition to the need of coverage and huge capacity bandwidth in cellular networks. Hence millimeter wave communication would reduce this hunger despite of its drawbacks in both access network and backhaul network. Foliage loss, atmosphere and distance affects the mmWave communication immensely. In this paper a solution to this issue is presented by the statistical channel modeling of a forest backhaul networks. It describes the Angle of Arrival (AoAs), Angle of Departure (AoD), power delay profiles and scatter plots for co-polarized and cross-polarized antennas at 60 GHz and 73 GHz.

articleTitle: A Mixed Convolutional Neural Network for Pre-miRNA Classification
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electrical, Computer & Telecommunication Engineering (ICECTE)
abstract: The biogenesis of miRNA is divided into two types based upon their different pathways. One of them is known as the canonical pathway and the other one is the mirtron pathway. This pathway depends on splicing rather than any enzyme. As the mirtron pathway is recently discovered, their identification is quite challenging due to less number of annotations. So the identification of mirtrons can be quite productive in understanding their functionality. Several machine learning algorithms have been introduced over the years based mostly upon calculated feature selection which produced good classification performance. We have also seen that neural networks like convolutional neural networks (CNN) applied on modified nucleotide sequences have given better performance. In this paper, we introduced an improved mixed convolutional neural network with multiple different sized filters and max-pooling layers using binary "one-hot" encoding and padding. We also used k-fold cross-validation and grid search to choose the values of hyperparameters. As we know neural networks tend to extract features automatically, our model did the same in the convolution and max-pooling layers. We evaluated our model in an independent test set and the results were quite satisfactory. We think our model can be used to predict mirtrons from nucleotide sequences. Even though we tried our best to fine-tune our model, we believe there's still room for improvement as CNN involves tuning of a number of hyperparameters. The files and source codes are available at https://github.com/zahidemon/Pre-miRNA-Classification.

articleTitle: Analysis of a Dual-Core Photonic Crystal Fiber Biosensor Based on Surface Plasmon Resonance
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electrical, Computer & Telecommunication Engineering (ICECTE)
abstract: A plain hexagonal cross section Photonic Crystal Fiber (PCF) biosensor dependent on Surface Plasmon Resonance (SPR) phenomenon is proposed here. Gold is used as plasmonic material in this work and to avoid fabrication complexity external coating is used. The proposed sensor is examined as far as wavelength and amplitude sensitivity. The sensor shows maximum wavelength and amplitude sensitivity up to 13,650 nm/RIU with a resolution of 7.32×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-6</sup> RIU and 1416 RIU<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup> with a resolution 7.06×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-6</sup> respectively. The sensor can detect the sample analyte ranging from 1.33 to 1.41. As the sensor shows promising result, so it can be used in many applications including biomedical engineering, organic chemical sensing, biomedical diagnostics and real time monitoring of biochemical reactions.

articleTitle: Predicting Lysine Glutarylation Sites by Combining Multiple Feature Selection Methods
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electrical, Computer & Telecommunication Engineering (ICECTE)
abstract: Lysine glutarylation is a dynamic and conserved post-translational modification of protein acylation. For identification of the molecular behavior of lysine glutarylation, it is necessary to identify the lysine glutarylation sites. Machine learning techniques help in the pathogenesis of biological mechanism processes to make a proper decision for developing glutarylated site identification. In this study, several feature encoding methods have been applied, i.e. amino acid factors (AAF), binary encoding (BE), and composition of k-spaced amino acid pairs (CKSAAP) to encode features from peptide sequences of lysine glutarylation modification database. Multiple feature selection methods have been used, i.e. Student's t-test, Kruskal-Wallis test, and minimum redundancy maximum relevance (mRMR) method to improve the prediction performance of the whole system reducing the number of features. A combined feature selection approach has been proposed. Moreover, due to the imbalance problem of the dataset, a biased support vector machine has been used as the classification model. The performance of different feature selection approaches has been measured according to the area under curve (AUC). Experimental studies show that the features that are selected by the combined approach provide better performance and efficiency than that of by individual approach.

articleTitle: A Statistical mmWave Channel Modeling for Railway Communications Backhaul in 5G Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electrical, Computer & Telecommunication Engineering (ICECTE)
abstract: Nowadays in LTE systems mobile video data traffic has made a large impact on the growth rate of data traffic globally, which is meant to be grapple with the 5G systems. Spectrum congestion issue has risen the use of unutilized millimeter wave (mmWave) spectrum for seamless wireless communications in 5G. Backhaul network (eNBs to core network) in railway communications can also utilize this mmWave band (10 GHz to 300 GHz). In order to ensure the efficient use of mmWave to overcome its drawbacks like propagation loss, atmospheric loss, rain fade etc. channel modeling is a foremost. This research is done by simulating in a novel software NYUSIM to show the omnidirectional, directional, small scale power delay profiles and scatter plot at carrier frequency 28 GHz and 60 GHz for two conditions: line of sight (LOS) and non-line of sight (NLOS). Notably, simulations results show that the RMS delay spread depends on the scenario whether LOS or NLOS irrespective of the distances between transmitter (Tx) to receiver (Rx).

articleTitle: Performance Investigation of Robust Linearly Constrained Minimum Variance Beamforming for Direction of Arrival Mismatch
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electrical, Computer & Telecommunication Engineering (ICECTE)
abstract: A robust linearly constrained minimum variance (LCMV) beamforming using directional and null constraints with a diagonal loading technique is discussed in this paper. The diagonal loading adds robustness against the direction of arrival mismatch and provides satisfactory output power and signal to interference plus noise ratio (SINR) in the mismatch region without broadening the beam. This paper first compares the proposed robust LCMV method with the conventional LCMV method in the presence of direction of arrival mismatch. Then its performance is compared with the LCMV using existed fixed diagonal loading method. The proposed robust method raises the output power by 1.88 dB and output SINR by 0.58 dB at 3 degree disparity angle compared to the LCMV with fixed diagonal loading technique. Simulations are performed in MATLAB to analyze the performance of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Energy-Efficient Hybrid Precoding Analysis in 5G mmWave massive MIMO Systems in Different Channels
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electrical, Computer & Telecommunication Engineering (ICECTE)
abstract: Millimeter-wave (mmWave) communication is very likely to emerge as a up-and-coming method in the next wireless generation (5G) era. Hybrid precoding architectures are broadly analyzed in mmWave massive multiple input multiple output (MIMO) systems because of its ability to mitigate the RF chains significantly. In most of the hybrid precoding networks, the analog processing part is implemented by phase shifters (PS) which consumes high energy, or by low-complexity switches (SW) which reduces the power consumption to a great extent; where both architectures consider simply mmWave channel. In this research, energy efficiency (EE) of a low-complexity SW-based hybrid precoding utilizing the antenna selection (AS) algorithm is analyzed for a mmWave m-MIMO system in various channels (e.g., Rayleigh, Rician and Nakagami-m fading channel). Simulation results indicate that the SW-based network enjoys a much higher EE than other schemes in each of the channels considered and therefore is an aspiring candidate for upcoming green communication approach.

articleTitle: Design and Optimization of Electromagnetically Actuated Bidirectional Microvalve
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electrical, Computer & Telecommunication Engineering (ICECTE)
abstract: This paper presents an analysis of the magnetic force generation and the membrane displacements of a bidirectional electromagnetic microvalve for drug delivery application. The proposed microvalve contains two arrays of equidistant micro-coils placed opposite to each other and a permanent magnet (NdFeB) attached to a flexible PDMS composite membrane. This work is primarily focused on the design of the bidirectional actuator and the performance analysis of the magnetic force on the PDMS membrane, generated by the magnet and the coil array. The magnetic force that is displacing the PDMS membrane is 8.3 mN and the membrane displacement is found to be 400 μm.

articleTitle: Security Against Multiple Eavesdroppers for Multicasting Over Nakagami-q Fading Channel
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electrical, Computer & Telecommunication Engineering (ICECTE)
abstract: A confidential multicasting scenario is considered through Nakagami-q fading channels in the presence of multiple eavesdroppers. We are interested to protect the confidential information so that no eavesdropper can decode any information from the multicast channels. A mathematical model is developed which consists of the closed-form analytical expressions for the ergodic secrecy multicast capacity and the secure outage probability for multicasting to ensure this security. Some numerical results are shown to justify the validity of the developed mathematical model. Moreover, the analytical expressions are verified via Monte-Carlo simulation.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Multiple Branch κ–µ Fading Wireless Channel
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electrical, Computer & Telecommunication Engineering (ICECTE)
abstract: The security over κ-μ fading distribution is analyzed in this paper to identify the multipath fading distributions that can be constituted from this fading model for security purposes. The closed-form analytical expressions (CFAEs) of security performance parameters such as probability of non-zero secrecy capacity (PNSC), secure outage probability (SOP) and the ergodic secrecy capacity (ESC) have been derived to get a proper insight of the effect of κ-μ fading parameters. Our results prove that the security performance of κ-μ fading channel includes the security performance of one sided Gaussian, Nakagami-m, Rician and Rayleigh fading channels. Finally, analytical results are tested by Monte-Carlo simulation.

articleTitle: Security in Wireless Multicast Networks with Exponential Correlation over Nakagami-m Fading Channels
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electrical, Computer & Telecommunication Engineering (ICECTE)
abstract: In this paper, we consider the problem of transmission of sensitive message in wireless multicast cellular network through identically distributed Nakagami-m fading multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) channels considering the existence of multiple eavesdroppers. It is assumed that the antennas in the destinations and eavesdroppers are exponentially correlated. Considering channel state information (CSI) at the receiver, the closed-form analytical expressions for the ergodic secrecy multicast capacity (ESMC) and the probability of non zero secrecy multicast capacity (PNSMC) have been derived to investigate the effect of correlation and fading parameter on the proposed model. Numerical results of the derived analytical expressions are presented and demonstrated using Monte-Carlo simulation.

Author Keywords: ergodic secrecy multicast capacity and probability of non zero secrecy multicast capacity

articleTitle: Smart Sentiment Analyzer for Bengali-English based on Hybrid Model
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electrical, Computer & Telecommunication Engineering (ICECTE)
abstract: This paper describes an intelligent sentiment analyzer incorporating linguistic knowledge. Our proposed method comprises three stages i) corpus construction, ii) classification using machine learning tools, and iii) linguistic knowledge integration in post processing stage if any misclassification occurs due to minor problem. Here, we applied nine supervised and ensemble learning approaches. From the experiments it is observed that the naïve Bayesian classifier with linguistic knowledge provides better accuracy (93%) on an average over the other classifiers using the 4-fold cross validation. Positive or negative or confused emotions with corresponding emoticons for both English and Bengali languages are determined and the results are demonstrated via an easy to use web based interface.

articleTitle: Security Analysis in Correlated Nakagami-m Fading Channels with Diversity Combining
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electrical, Computer & Telecommunication Engineering (ICECTE)
abstract: This paper investigates the effect of exponential antenna correlation on the secrecy performance of Nakagami-m fading correlated channels in the presence of an eavesdropper. Diversity combining techniques are imposed to reduce the effect of that exponential correlation. The closed-form analytical expressions (CFAEs) for the ergodic secrecy capacity (EGC), probability of non-zero secrecy capacity (PNZSC) and the secure outage probability(SOP) are derived to facilitate the investigation clearly. Our results show that the effect of exponential antenna correlation in Nakagami-m fading channel significantly affects the security. But the antenna diversity is the best solution to reduce that effect maintaining a tradeoff between the number of antennas and the intensity of correlation. Finally, the validity of analytical expressions are checked via Monte-Carlo simulations.

articleTitle: Predictive Current Control of a Simplified Three-Level Neutral-Point Clamped Inverter
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electrical, Computer & Telecommunication Engineering (ICECTE)
abstract: A three-level neutral point clamped (3L-NPC) inverter is built with a larger number of semiconductor devices. Therefore, predictive current control (PCC) of 3L-NPC faces two issues regarding the reliability and computational cost. To overcome the problem, this paper presents predictive current control of a three-level simplified neutral-point clamped (3L-SNPC) inverter. Due to having the simplicity of adding a newer constraint in the cost function, the capacitor voltages of NPC inverter are perfectly balanced. Simulation results indicate that the proposed PCC based SNPC inverter yields similar performance as obtained with the conventional 3L-NPC. However, the SNPC inverter requires eight less number of semiconductor devices, which enhances the reliability and reduces the computational burden of the proposed system. In comparison to conventional 3L-NPC, the computational burden is reduced by 27.78%.

articleTitle: Energy-Efficient Hybrid Precoding Analysis in 5G mmWave massive MIMO Systems with Large Antenna Arrays
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electrical, Computer & Telecommunication Engineering (ICECTE)
abstract: Millimeter wave (mmWave) massive MIMO system considers the hybrid precoding scheme because of its low cost and low power consumption. Fully-connected architecture which requires high phase shifters tend to more energy consume. On the other hand, sub-connected architecture consumes less energy compare to other. For more energy efficiency, the hybrid precoding scheme which is based on successive interference cancellation (SIC) is considered. We use this SIC based schemes to exploit green communication aspects for large antenna arrays through different wireless channels, e.g., Rayleigh, Rician, Nakagami-m, and mmWave. The simulated result exhibits the high energy efficiency of SIC scheme compare to other conventional schemes.

articleTitle: Protection of Multicast Channels Against Multiple Eavesdroppers: A Secrecy Tradeoff
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electrical, Computer & Telecommunication Engineering (ICECTE)
abstract: The conventional multicasting techniques do not ensure security for the destination users. This paper deals with the solution of this problem. A confidential communication scenario is proposed where a single antenna source communicates with a group of multicast users each with multiple antennas in the presence of multiple eavesdroppers each with multiple antennas. The key contribution of this paper is to provide a mathematical model consisting of the closed-form analytical expressions (CFAEs) for the probability of non-zero secrecy multicast capacity (PNSMC), secure outage probability for multicasting (SOPM) and the ergodic secrecy multicast capacity (ESMC) to obstruct the eavesdropper, so that no eavesdropper can decode any information from the multicast channels. Finally, the derived analytical expressions are verified via Monte-Carlo simulation.

articleTitle: Order Dependency in Sequential Correlation
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electrical, Computer & Telecommunication Engineering (ICECTE)
abstract: Data analytics is a core part of the fast-moving world in the modern era, and its origin is data mining. SSequential pattern mining is a cutting-edge studies location of facts mining. An easy sample mining technique is inadequate to apprehend the connection among the objects in a dataset. A correlation degree may be extra beneficial to decide the dependency among the entities. We suggest a method in this paper that can evaluate the relationship’s strengths and the degree of order. While assessing the ranking of dependency, we use one way and reverse connections. Moreover, To determine the order of dependency, we use one method and contrary relationships. Sequential correlations are widely applicable in the sector of diagnosing disease, optimize the internet, and develop active retail strategies.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of MODENAR and MOEA for Mining Association Rules
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electrical, Computer & Telecommunication Engineering (ICECTE)
abstract: Evolutionary algorithms have significant impact on association rule mining. These algorithms can be single objective or multi-objective, depending on the intended result. Both Multi-Objective Evolutionary Algorithm (MOEA) and Multi-Objective Differential Evolution Algorithm for Mining Numeric Association Rules (MODENAR) are multi-objective algorithms but uses different objectives. MOEA is an algorithm that mines association rules from a dataset that contains any type of attributes. Contrarily, MODENAR was proposed for mining numeric association rules and this algorithm was not compared to any other algorithms by the authors. To our apprehension, no such work has been done till now that compares MODENAR with other association rule mining algorithms. So, this paper will compare MODENAR with another association rule mining algorithm, named MOEA and demonstrate the results by applying above mentioned algorithms on different datasets.

articleTitle: A Statistical Channel Modeling for MIMO-OFDM Beamforming System in 5G mmWave Communications
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electrical, Computer & Telecommunication Engineering (ICECTE)
abstract: The rapid increase of demanding data rates have push the button of aspiration to work with Fifth Generation (5G) network. Millimeter Wave (mmWave) with a wide bandwidth has made the path one step ahead to solve this problem. In this paper we consider a MIMO OFDM (Multiple Input Multiple Output Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing) beamformers for mmWave channels. Here we use statistical value of channel to make hybrid beamformers and hybrid combiners. As the RF (radio frequency) chain is short, we make a latest model comparing with previous one which can reduce the problem. Simulation results represent the enhancement of minimizing the loss of SNR, increasing the average SNR and transmission rate clearly.

articleTitle: Statistical Channel Model at mmWave Band Inside High Speed Water Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electrical, Computer & Telecommunication Engineering (ICECTE)
abstract: Recent research works anticipates development in technological applications related to marine wireless channels. This is the field of wireless channel model related research which is yet to be explored. This article provides channel model based on simulation inside high speed water vehicle over sea surface. Taking into account both the limitations of millimeter wave technique over-the-sea surface propagation and enlarging demand of users led to this research on modeling maritime channel model inside high speed water vehicle. Both spatial and temporal characteristics with propagation delay parameters have been discussed in this work. This paper is focused on 38 and 60 GHz because of 38 GHz having the minimum water attenuation in sea environments and 60 GHz showing best performance in indoor short range communication. Our results and analysis using 5G and mmWave and simulated channel model will be advantageous for sea environments and indoor wireless communications in high speed water vehicle. The results presented here may facilitate improvements in the future researches in relevant works.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Feedback Method for FDD Massive MIMO in Device-to-device Communications
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electrical, Computer & Telecommunication Engineering (ICECTE)
abstract: Massive MIMO is a key enabling technology for 5G. For efficient application of massive MIMO, frequency division duplexing (FDD) is considered as a better technique. But feed-back of channel state information (CSI) is a challenging task in FDD. This paper studies a conventional CSI feedback scheme and evaluate a cooperative precoder feedback scheme for CSI sharing via device-to-device (D2D) communication between users. This method is more efficient in minimizing interference and reducing delays. The fluctuation of sum rate for different transmission powers and carrier frequencies are measured. Numerical results provide sum rate against different sectors like additional blockage for 2nd user, total transmission power, number of bits required to feedback and delays for D2D CSI exchange. Simulation results illustrate that cooperative CSI feedback method outperforms all other feedback methods for FDD massive MIMO.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Solar Based Wireless Power Transmission System
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electrical, Computer & Telecommunication Engineering (ICECTE)
abstract: Wireless power transmission based on resonant inductive method can be achieved for applications covering shorter distances. Since wireless applications have become such a widespread need among both consumers and businesses, the technology is constantly improving and becoming more common in industries all across the globe. Furthermore, by utilizing renewable energy like solar power, this technology could become even a bigger revolution. The main advantage of the system would be less emission of CO as well as less effects in global warming. This paper provides simulation results of wireless power transfer utilizing solar energy. It also analyzes the performance of the system with respect to variation in parameters like coil shape, input frequency, coil sliding, load resistance etc.

articleTitle: Investigation of Energy Efficiency in Underlaid D2D Assisted 5G Cellular Network
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electrical, Computer & Telecommunication Engineering (ICECTE)
abstract: Next generation wireless standard 5G is expected to meet huge spectrum demand by enabling new technology, i.e., device to device communication (D2D). This technology enhances spectrum efficiency (SE) while interference management due to device proximity is challenging by coordinating transmission power between cellular and D2D users, i.e., underlaid approach. Another key design requirement fr 5G is energy efficiency (EE). In this research, we investigate the EE of cellular network which is underlaid with D2D for multiple bands while considering several network criteria such as different bandwidths (BW), path loss exponents (PLE), transmission power required for cellular users (CU) and D2D users (DU), reference distances between CU and DU, outage threshold for DU, user density for CU and DU upon the changes. Simulation results demonstrate the truthful impact of these parameters.

articleTitle: Cost Effective Bluetooth Technology Based Home Automation System Using Smart-phone Application
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electrical, Computer & Telecommunication Engineering (ICECTE)
abstract: This paper presents a cost effective smart home automation system. The earlier version of home automation system used in the developed countries is very costly and complex for the users. Now a days, with the rapid growth of technologies in the developing countries, a smart home automation system is being adopted in many places. The developed system is very easy to operate by using smartphone and it is especially recommended for its low installation and maintenance cost. The whole system has been developed by using Bluetooth technology and smartphone application with indispensable hardware connections like Arduino, relay switching circuits etc.

articleTitle: Early Detection of Sepsis in ICU Patients Using Logistic Regression
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electrical, Computer & Telecommunication Engineering (ICECTE)
abstract: Sepsis is a dangerous condition that happens when the body's reaction to contamination results in tissue harm, failure of organs, or sometimes even death. Early recognition and anti-infection sepsis-treatment are basic to enhancing sepsis results, where every hour of deferred treatment has been related with an escalation in mortality. Along these lines, this image gives a reasonable view as to the significance of early discovery of sepsis. This study focuses on detecting the onset of sepsis based on 40 features from ICU patients using the logistic regression classifier. The heavy class imbalance between septic and nonseptic patients is addressed by giving more weight to the minority class. Pearson correlation coefficient was used to select the features useful to predict the target variable and the data was standardized afterwards. Using the scoring system provided by PhysioNet/Computing in Cardiology (CinC) Challenge 2019 ,the model achieved a score of 32.4% on the training dataset (20336 subjects) and 14% on the unseen test dataset (20000 subjects).

articleTitle: Performance Comparison of Opportunistic Relaying in Nakagami-m and Rician-k Fading Channels Focusing on Wireless Security
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electrical, Computer & Telecommunication Engineering (ICECTE)
abstract: This paper deals with the performance comparison of opportunistic relaying technique in enhancing security of Nakagami-m and Rician-k fading channels considering the existence of an eavesdropper. To draw the conclusion of this comparison, the expressions for the ergodic secrecy capacity and secure outage probability have been derived in closed-form which help to understand the insight of the effect of system parameters easily. The results show that, the opportunistic relaying with the same number of relays and for the same diversity gain, confidential data transmission in Nakagami-m fading channel is more secured than that of Rician-k fading channel. Lastly, numerical results have been verified via Monte-Carlo simulation.

articleTitle: Improving Patient Cohort Identification using Neural Word Embedding with Structured Analysis
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electrical, Computer & Telecommunication Engineering (ICECTE)
abstract: Patient cohort is similar symptoms of group of patients over a time period. It is important to correctly identify patient cohort for observational study or interventional study. To identify patient cohort, we can easily retrieve information from large structured and unstructured data tables, but this information may not fulfill our interest. We need to obtain knowledge from the unstructured medical data for further detailed inspection. In this work, we have improved structured extraction by presenting context on a health record dataset for identifying cohort of diabetic patients. Results shows that traditional structured query-based data extraction methods accurately identified 97.14% positive patients to our question of interest where adding natural language processing supported technique have retrieved 98.37% precisely.

articleTitle: Ultra Low Loss Photonic Crystal Fiber Plasmonic Bio-sensor
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electrical, Computer & Telecommunication Engineering (ICECTE)
abstract: This article presents, a photonic crystal fiber (PCF) with four layers hexagonal formation of air holes for sensing index of refraction (RI). Numerical investigation is performed between the analyte detection ranges from 1.38 to 1.42 by using the finite element method (FEM). Simulation by this method reveal the maximum wavelength sensitivity (WS) of 20,000 nm/RIU and the amplitude sensitivity (AS) of 718 RIU<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>. The maximum sensor resolution (SR) is computed as 5×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-5</sup> RIU. In addition, the maximum value of the confinement loss (CL) is as low as 2.15 × 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-4</sup> dB/cm. Therefore, the sensor can be compatible for detecting anonymous bio-molecular analytes on account of having remarkable sensing performance.

articleTitle: Secure Wireless Multicasting Over Generalized Gamma Fading Channels
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electrical, Computer & Telecommunication Engineering (ICECTE)
abstract: The issue of wireless security in Generalized gamma fading is considered in this paper with multiple eavesdropper present in the system. The analysis of security is performed based on the investigation of the parametric effects of Generalized gamma fading channel. The expressions for the measures of the security such as probability of positive secrecy capacity and the secure outage probability are derived in closed-form to facilitate the investigation of that parametric effects. Our results illustrates that the analysis of security in Generalized gamma fading channels introduces a conclusion about the effects of fading parameters in the security of Weibull, Rayleigh and Nakagami-m fading channels. Finally, the analytical results are verified via Monte-Carlo simulation.

Author Keywords: probability of positive secrecy multicast capacity

articleTitle: Robust Cylindrical Antenna Array using Optimal Diagonal Loading Technique in the Presence of Steering Angle Mismatch
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electrical, Computer & Telecommunication Engineering (ICECTE)
abstract: This paper introduces a cylindrical antenna array (CAA). The performance of this CAA is investigated and contrasted with traditional concentric circular antenna array (CCAA). Optimal CAA is compared with delay-and-sum (DAS) CAA and found that optimal CAA has higher interference cancellation ability in the presence of interference. The performance of optimal CAA is deteriorated if intended signal turns away from beam steering direction. The performance deterioration issue because of steering angle disparity (SAD), can be diminished by using fixed and variable diagonal loading robust techniques. From numerical results of MATLAB, it is ascertained that the half-power beamwidth (HPBW) of suggested CAA is 36.35% narrower than traditional CCAA. Due to narrow beamwidth, the directivity of proposed CAA is superior and also side lobe level (SLL) is lower than existing CCAA. ODL based CAA delivers more robustness in case of SAD compared with existing FDL based CAA.

articleTitle: Sub Diffraction Imaging Using Wire Array Metamaterial
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electrical, Computer & Telecommunication Engineering (ICECTE)
abstract: The electromagnetic properties of naturally available media are greatly restricted by physical reasons. This leads to the development of artificial material called metamaterial. This complex metamaterial makes it possible to obtain extraordinary electromagnetic response absent in available natural materials. A special class of metamaterials having hyperbolic dispersion profile are the wire media (WM), comprised of sub-wavelength array of metal wires that allows them to support high spatial frequencies and beat the diffraction limit. The WM possess flat iso-frequency contour and these properties offer brilliant application in optics hence, transmits energy only in one direction with same velocity. Here we have studied the imaging through conventional system and image formation using different types of dielectrics where the WM is mounted.

articleTitle: Effect of Beam Divergence on the Performance of Underwater Wireless SAC-OCDMA System using MQC Code
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electrical, Computer & Telecommunication Engineering (ICECTE)
abstract: We have introduced an underwater wireless spectral-amplitude-coding optical code division multiple access (SAC-OCDMA) system by using modified quadratic congruence (MQC) code is in this paper. The main attraction of this system is the reduced multi-user interference (MUI). Balanced detection technique is implemented using two Si avalanche photo-detectors (APDs) at the receiver section. The BER of the system is calculated by considering the influence of thermal noise, phase-induced intensity noise (PIIN) and shot noise. The effect of different beam divergence angle on the BER performance of the system in various types of seawater channel such as pure seawater, clear ocean water and coastal ocean water, is investigated in this paper as the system performance is highly dependent on the optical source's beam divergence angle and the water channel types. The investigation stipulates that, the system gives it's best performance in pure sea water at a narrow beam divergence angle. Nonetheless the alignment of the transmitter and receiver should be explicit for narrow divergence angle which is difficult to implement.

articleTitle: Cranking Behavior Observation at Different Temperatures of Sealed Maintenance Free Automotive Lead Acid Battery
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electrical, Computer & Telecommunication Engineering (ICECTE)
abstract: Automotive Lead Acid batteries are mainly used to supply high cranking current to start mechanical engines or generators. In this paper, performance of NS60L (JIS Type 46B24L) 45AH Automotive Sealed Maintenance Free (SMF) Lead Acid batteries with specific manufacturing process have been studied through different tests such as Cold Cranking Ampere, Resistivity, Conductivity, High Rate Discharge. All tests were conducted between temperatures 26°C to -15°C. Additional tests such as Capacity, Life Cycle, Porosity tests were conducted to examine plate quality and battery life. Finally, test database has been examined and quantitatively summarized to find out cranking characteristics for SMF battery with particular manufacturing parameters.

articleTitle: Identification of Biomarkers for Head and Neck Cancer by Analyzing Multiple mRNA Expression Datasets
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electrical, Computer & Telecommunication Engineering (ICECTE)
abstract: Identifying biomarkers play a vital role in some clinical applications like diagnosis, prognosis, and drug selecting. Being the fifth common and frequent cancer in the world and having a poor survival rate, it makes Head and Neck squamous cell carcinoma (HNSCC) one of the most studied concern. Knowing the lack of effective and reliable biomarkers along with its high mortality rate, finding biomarkers from deferentially expressed genes can reduce the mortality rate. In our research paper, we studied different mRNA micro-array datasets (GSE6631 and GSE12452) for the identification of deferentially expressed genes. With the implementation of a parametric test (Student’s t-test) to identify the deferentially expressed genes with log fold change values. With careful inspection, we found a list of deferentially expressed genes consist of 365 up-regulated and 283 down-regulated genes in total by using Student t-test while keeping the p-value less than 0.05. Finally, after extensive analysis, two genes (PSPH and DST) were selected among them. With an overall endurance inspection, it indicates that PSPH and DST were associated with overall durability. Consequently, PSPH and DST can be the possible biomarkers and can act as a therapeutic objective to enhance the survival rate of Head and Neck Cancers. All the files and code which we used in this research paper are available at https://github.com/AmitHasanShuvo/BiomarkersHNSC

articleTitle: PV Array Based Ultra-Fast Charging Strategy for Li-Ion Battery Considering Temperature Rise
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electrical, Computer & Telecommunication Engineering (ICECTE)
abstract: Solar energy can be captured by Photovoltaic (PV) array which can be used for charging Lithium-Ion (Li-Ion) batteries. This paper is concerned with the study of ultra-fast charging of a Li-Ion battery. Pulse charging technique provides this charging scheme in this case and the result is compared with the Constant Current (CC) charging method. The charging time of the selected battery is decreased in a condition that the temperature rise of it is measurable. Thereby, 7.4V and 5.4Ah Li-Ion battery is chosen and simulated by adopting two charging methods mentioned above. Full charging time by the proposed technique is 2558 seconds and 2575 seconds for the CC method with battery temperature of about 38.54°C and 45.03°C respectively. Hence, around 17 seconds time saving is found with 6.49°C less temperature rise.

articleTitle: Audio Future Block Prediction with Conditional Generative Adversarial Network
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electrical, Computer & Telecommunication Engineering (ICECTE)
abstract: Signal processing is a vast subfield of electrical and computer science where audio signal processing has secured a remarkable position to restore corrupted or missing audio blocks. However, generating possible future audio block from the previous audio block is still a new idea that can help to reduce both audio noise and partially missing an audio segment. In this paper, a generative adversarial network (GAN) along with a pipeline is proposed for the prediction of possible audio after an input audio sequence. The proposed model uses short-time Fourier transformation of audio to make it an image. The image is then fed to a conditional GAN to predict the output image. After that, Inverse short-time Fourier transform is then applied to that predicted image, generating the predicted audio sequence. For a small audio sequence prediction, the proposed methodology is quite fast, robust and has achieved a loss of 0.43. So it is may work well if deployed on a voice call and broadcasting applications.

articleTitle: Structural, Electronic and Optical Properties of Pristine and Doped B16 Nanocluster: A DFT Study
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electrical, Computer & Telecommunication Engineering (ICECTE)
abstract: In this research, we demonstrated density functional theory (DFT) calculations using widely accepted B3LYP/SDD theory to investigate the structural, electronic and optical property for both pristine B<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">16</inf> and metal (Na, K) doped B<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">16</inf> structures. For the doping with the less electronegative atom (K<Na), HOMO-LUMO energy gap was decreased with an increase of the dipole moment. The order of dipole moment is K-B<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">16</inf> > Na-B<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">16</inf> > B<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">16</inf>. In addition, reactivity and stability of the structures were analyzed and global indices were calculated. For doped structures, UV-Vis spectrum confirms the absorption of light in the visible range and DOS spectrum was used to calculate the possible states of the structures.

articleTitle: Design and Economic Evaluation of Fixed Dome Type Biogas Power Plant for Poultry Waste
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electrical, Computer & Telecommunication Engineering (ICECTE)
abstract: In the time of fourth industrial revolution the renewable energy resources like poultry waste can play a vital role to generate electricity. To manipulate this energy resource various pilot projects are being undertaken through Bangladesh. To facilitate this process a proposal with efficient design of a platform for a medium scale poultry farms (e.g. having 5000 utilizable birds) in order to generate electrical energy using poultry waste is analyzed in this work. Moreover, from an effective plant of a farm, the farmer can sell the existing power to the nearby utilities after fulfilling its own requirements, hence reducing the burden of national grid. Again, the fertilizer obtained as a byproduct in this process can also be a source of earning. The acceptance of the model on the basis of economic analysis has also been evaluated. It is found that if electricity is only used as the earning source then Net Present Value (NPV) is 15,08,542 BDT (17,869 USD) and payback period is 2.36 years and if both electricity and fertilizer is taken into consideration then they are 15,89,841 BDT (18,832 USD) and 2.30 years respectively. So, the proposed model can be considered as an acceptable one as the NPV in both cases is positive.

articleTitle: Robust Hexagonal Antenna Array Beamforming in Appearance of Steering Angle Disparity
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electrical, Computer & Telecommunication Engineering (ICECTE)
abstract: In this paper, we present an antenna structure called uniform hexagonal antenna array (UHAA) to evaluate its performance using a robust algorithm in case of disparity between steering direction and original signal direction. UHAA structured beamformer is chosen due to its symmetrical structure and it can scan signal over 360 degree. The proposed array's performance is contrasted with existing concentric circular antenna arrays (CCAA) to justify the superiority of the proposed UHAA. Moreover, optimal and delay-and-sum beamforming techniques are applied to the UHAA in the appearance of interference signal and steering direction error, and performance degradation of optimal UHAA is observed if the desired signal slightly deviates from the desired direction. To resolve this problem, a robust technique called fixed diagonal loading (FDL) technique is applied which makes the system robust enough. From the simulation result, improved half power beam-width (HPBW) as well as directivity are observed as both are 20.83% and 42.70% better than analysed CCAA. UHAA requires less area to install compared to CCAA for same antenna elements, and it also exhibits superior outcome if there is a error in expected signal direction and steering direction.

articleTitle: Hyperbolic Metamaterial for Sub-diffraction Imaging at THz Frequencies
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electrical, Computer & Telecommunication Engineering (ICECTE)
abstract: One of the main problems with the traditional imaging systems is that they can't support high spatial frequencies (i.e., high-k modes) evanescent waves, and thus results in classical diffraction limit. Metamaterials, especially, hyperbolic metamaterials can support high-k modes, and such modes are often wont to beat the diffraction limit. Here, we present an area 2D homogenized metamaterial slab as imaging device at THz frequencies. employing a simple analytical model and a transfer matrix method (TMM), we calculate transmission properties of slab. From the straightforward analytical model, we show that the metamaterial slab can resolve feature sizes below the diffraction limit. Our analytical model also confirms that transmission is unity at the Fabry-Perot resonances (FPRs), resulting in good image, and at off-FPRs, resonant enhancement of evanescent waves occurs at certain spatial frequencies, resulting in severe image distortion.

articleTitle: Optimization of Performance Parameter of Microstrip Patch Antenna in Millimeter Wave Region
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electrical, Computer & Telecommunication Engineering (ICECTE)
abstract: In this paper, a square shaped microstrip patch antenna functioning in the millimeter wave region is designed to optimize the performance parameters. This proposed antenna will be resonate at 60 GHz. This antenna comprises of a square patch where an H slot and double E slots are inserted on that patch to convert the antenna to a wider band. The antenna has been designed utilizing microstrip inset line feed to coordinate the impedance. The substrate is made by dielectric material Rogers RT 5880 having permittivity of 2.2 and its height is taken around 0.95 mm. The performance parameters such as return loss, VSWR, gain and bandwidth have been examined and also comparative analysis has been made with the output of reference antenna.

Author Keywords: an H slot and double E slots

articleTitle: Plasmonic Polarizer on Photonic Crystal Fiber for Two Communication Windows
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electrical, Computer & Telecommunication Engineering (ICECTE)
